key_insight: Curvature-Scaled SAM uniformly controls gradient distortion under generalized smoothness, enabling convergence guarantees where standard SAM can cycle and USAM can diverge.
engineering_relevance: Curvature-aware scaling offers a principled way to adapt sharpness-aware training beyond the restrictive assumption of globally smooth objectives.
method: Measure relative gradient distortion caused by sharpness-aware perturbations.
Scale both the perturbation and descent step using curvature upper bounds.
Prove deterministic O(1/T) stationarity and convex function-gap rates, plus linear convergence under the Polyak–Łojasiewicz condition.
evidence_signal: In minibatch computer vision experiments, the (H0,H1) variant achieved the highest mean best-test accuracy in all four settings against tuned SAM and USAM with constant and cosine schedules.
watch_item: The guarantees are deterministic and rely on suitable curvature upper bounds; the abstract does not establish equivalent minibatch convergence guarantees.
paper_title: Curvature-Scaled Sharpness-Aware Minimization: Convergence Beyond Smoothness
